QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Conspiracy
QuestInfo.0: You entered the Crack in Time, and now you're face-to-face with the Goddess of Time, #b#p2144000##k. What does one say to a goddess?
QuestInfo.1: You heard about Arkarium's conspiracy and the crack he made.
QuestInfo.2: You need to deliver the information about Arkarium's plans to Bastille.\n
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] To the Past quest

0.0: I'm #p2144000#, the Goddess of Time. To be precise, I'm her mind charged with a little bit of power. #h0#, I don't think I'll be able to have a long conversation because I'm so far away from my main body. Listen now, mortal, for we can't waste any...well, you know.\r\n#L0##bWhat's going on here?#l\n#k
0.1: The old Guardian of Time, #r#p2144010##k, is trying to eliminate the heroes by traveling back to a time before the Black Mage was sealed. You must stop him.\r\n#L0# #bHow did he manage that?!#l\n#k
0.2: #p2144010# created a Crack in Time and opened a door to the past. The details are unimportant; what matters is that you must chase him through time and stop him!

yes.0: I hope I can defeat Arkarium and protect Maple World's peace...

no.0: If you don't stop #p2144010#, Maple World will be destroyed!

1.0: You must hurry and tell Bastille what Rhinne said!
